daily.today_energy: Your mind is buzzing with creative possibilities today, Gemini. This is your moment to lean into curiosity and let those random thoughts flow—they're actually cosmic breadcrumbs leading somewhere meaningful.
daily.love: Connection feels lighter and more playful right now. Whether you're single or coupled, there's magic in honest conversations and genuine laughter. Let your walls down a bit; vulnerability is actually your superpower today.
daily.career: Your communication skills are at peak performance—use them to pitch ideas, collaborate, or clarify something that's been unclear. The energy supports bold moves, but trust your intuition on timing.
daily.health: Your nervous system wants attention. Try grounding activities like walking, journaling, or just sitting with your thoughts. Your body's asking you to slow down just enough to recalibrate.

weekly.overview: Mercury's doing its thing this week, Gemini. You're entering a phase where your natural curiosity feels amplified—conversations are hitting different, and people genuinely want to hear what you have to say. Trust that vibe.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled or solo, this week's energy is about authenticity over performance. Someone might surprise you with real talk, or you might finally say the thing you've been holding back. Either way, vulnerability looks good on you rn.
weekly.career: Your ideas are premium this week—the universe is literally handing you permission to pitch that project or speak up in meetings. Your voice carries weight, so use it. Collaboration flows naturally; lean into teamwork and watch momentum build.
